follow-up time: Duration of second stage of labor
exposure: Prolonged second stage of labor (>= 3 h)
cohort: The study included 191 nulliparous women with a second stage of labor of >= 3 h and a documented AOP measurement during the second stage.
finding: Ultrasound-assessed fetal head station in nulliparous women with a protracted second stage of labor, specifically AOP, can accurately predict the mode and interval time to delivery in real-life clinical practice.
mod_finding: A wider AOP was associated with a higher rate of vaginal delivery, with an AOP >= 127 degrees indicating an 88.6% vaginal delivery rate.
